clips.title: The story
paras: A summons bearing the Tome of Divinity calls promising paladins from Elwynn to Stormwind. Answering Brother Wilhelm's call begins the sacred trials needed to master resurrection through the Holy Light.

Novice paladins in Elwynn Forest spend their early days helping locals and testing their strength against wolves, Defias bandits, and kobolds. When an initiate shows martial discipline and devotion to the Holy Light, mentors such as Brother Wilhelm send a personal summons. Leaders of the paladins take note of promising students and direct them to leave the local chapels behind and report straight to the kingdom's spiritual heart.

In Cathedral Square, Stormwind's Cathedral of Light is the supreme sanctuary of the kingdom's priesthood and the Knights of the Silver Hand. Duthorian Rall resides there and oversees those sworn to the Order. Beneath its soaring vaulted ceilings, high-ranking paladins set formal trials from the Tome of Divinity before each initiate. The challenges test compassion, fortitude, and a willingness to sacrifice.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, brother. Duthorian Rall, one of our most influential adventurers, was speaking about you recently. I overheard him talking about how it was time you be put to the test some... Along with some very complimentary things about how well you've performed thus far.
If I were you, I'd head to Stormwind and speak to him when you have time. I'm sure he's in the Cathedral of Light--that's where he spends most of his time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is beautiful here in Stormwind, is it not?
Your timing actually couldn't have been better, friend.
